an5.82:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.82:1.3: Avītarāgo hoti, avītadoso hoti, avītamoho hoti makkhī ca palāsī ca.
an5.82:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca. 3.

an5.82:2.3: Vītarāgo hoti, vītadoso hoti,vītamoho hoti amakkhī ca apalāsī ca.
